unit: one complete cleaned body; multi-label, each label separately judged
source: 帖子表达变量_细分编码手册_v3.md

record_fields.positive_labels: array of codes with definite positive judgement
record_fields.uncertain_labels: array of codes with genuinely uncertain judgement
record_fields.evidence: object mapping every positive code to an exact nonempty substring of the body, and no other codes
record_fields.note: string with any necessary uncertainty or context
record_fields.all_labels_reviewed: boolean true after all nine labels were examined, not an accuracy claim
record_fields.exhortation_target: required enum; V3_EXHORT positive => self/others/both/unspecified/uncertain; V3_EXHORT uncertain => uncertain; V3_EXHORT negative => not_applicable; insufficient => uncertain

rules: Do not expose raw text, author or outcome publicly.
positive_labels and uncertain_labels are disjoint subsets of the nine label codes.
For readable records all_labels_reviewed must be true; only then can absent codes be interpreted as explicit negative.
For insufficient records positive_labels and uncertain_labels are empty but every label is unavailable, never zero.
Every positive code needs exact nonempty original substring evidence, with enough context to support interpretation.
Unspecified or uncertain encouragement target is unknown for self/other variants, not two negatives.
Every label can coexist; categories are neither mutually exclusive nor complete.
V2 merged positives cannot automatically be split into v3 positives; old negatives are candidates, not truth.
